children: Pakistan's Foreign Ministry said Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar will travel to New York from September 21 to 25 to attend the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly. According to Sina Finance, Dar will meet the Organization of Islamic Cooperation's Kashmir contact group during the meetings and take part in other ministerial meetings. He will attend the Arab-Islamic Eight-Nation Group meeting and speak at a high-level briefing on artificial intelligence at the UN Security Council. Dar will also hold bilateral talks with foreign ministers from several countries and accompany Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to bilateral meetings.

title: Pakistan's Foreign Minister Dar to Attend UN Meetings in New York
